build_TranslationLevenshteinTask: build a Levenshtein Transformer translation task for iterative sequence generation with noise injection
inject_noise_random_delete: inject random delete noise into target tokens preserving bos and eos special tokens
inject_noise_random_mask: inject random mask noise by replacing target tokens with unk tokens based on random scoring
build_IterativeRefinementGenerator: build an iterative refinement generator for Levenshtein Transformer decoding with configurable beam size and max iterations
train_step_with_noise: run a training step that injects noise into target tokens before computing loss and backpropagating
